name: codex-decision
description: One Decision switch for line-by-line filtering of supported local tool output.

interface.longDescription: Codex Decision adds one local PostToolUse filter for supported plain-text tool results. One session switch controls all output. A Rust hook validates known output formats locally, then asks OpenAI Decisions or TypeSafe Jev for independent line relevance judgments in API-bounded batches. Unrecognized formats use a conservative sampled classification. Code protects diagnostics and exact evidence. Failed or unsupported results remain intact. Every shortened result points to a private, exact original. The standalone hook requires explicit enablement and the selected provider’s API key. The optional VS Code control enables Decision for new local threads and provides one on/off button. The integrated VS Code package bundles this hook, skill, control, and verified composer repair in one install. This package contains a Linux x86_64 hook binary; other execution environments need their own native binary.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up Codex Decision for test logs.
Check whether this Decision-shortened result kept the evidence I need.
